'''Maby Sagedo''' was an [[alien]] [[masseur]] and a colleague of [[Lexo Sooger]] at [[Zord's Spa and Bathhouse]] in [[Canto Bight]].<ref name="Hear Nothing, See Nothing, Say Nothing" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Masseur-Alien-02.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Masseur Alien 02 by Jake Lunt Davies]]
Maby Sagedo was first mentioned in the short story ''[[Hear Nothing, See Nothing, Say Nothing]]'' from the [[Canto Bight (novella collection)|Canto Bight]] novella collection, written by [[Rae Carson]].<ref name="Novella">{{StoryCite|story=Hear Nothing, See Nothing, Say Nothing|book=Canto Bight (novella collection)}}</ref> Keeper of the Holocron, [[Leland Chee]], later confirmed that they were one of the masseurs featured in the [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] deleted scenes.<ref name="Discord">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-03|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1357405484679958799|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-Masseur-Species.png}}</ref> They were designed by [[Jake Lunt Davies]], with their concept art being titled titled "Masseur Alien 02,"<ref name="TLJ Art Book">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref> while their production code was "K066B species" or "King 66B."<ref name="Discord" />
